description: This file defines the PurchaseFlowView React component for a web application, handling the purchase flow UI including signing in, creating accounts, and UI controls such as closing the flow.

classes.name: PurchaseFlowPaneSelector
classes.description: A React FunctionComponent that switches between different panes (CreateAccount, SignIn) based on the currentPurchaseFlowPane state.

classes.name: PurchaseFlowView
classes.description: Main React FunctionComponent rendering the purchase flow overlay including header, close button, and pane content.

methods.name: PurchaseFlowPaneSelector
methods.description: Selects and renders the appropriate pane component based on the current pane state.

methods.name: PurchaseFlowView
methods.description: Renders the overall purchase flow UI, including overlay, close button, logo, and pane selector component.
